# Darshil Jain: full profile

> BBA (Business & Industry) student at Maharaja Surajmal Institute, GGSIPU, Delhi, working across operations, strategy and people. Three internships, a paid startup consulting engagement and a student club built from zero to 80+ members.

The complete text of Darshify (https://wrapped-portfolio.vercel.app), Darshil Jain's portfolio, in one file. A shorter map is at https://wrapped-portfolio.vercel.app/llms.txt.

Darshil Jain is a BBA (Business & Industry) student at Maharaja Surajmal Institute, affiliated with Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU), in Janakpuri, Delhi. Class of 2027, CGPA 9.39. Darshil works across operations, strategy and people.

Darshil has interned in operations at Figmenta and PSR Compliance and in human resources at MJ Marketing Consultancy: screening 500+ résumés, running compliance workflows for 70+ clients and coordinating 100+ interviews. Darshil also consulted for the AI healthcare startup ZautoAI on a paid engagement that helped it become a finalist at IIHMR Saamarthya 5.0.

Darshil founded the institute's Igniters Club chapter (powered by Unstop), grew it from 0 to 80+ members in 10 months and led Converge 2026, the institute's largest management fest, with 1,000+ participants and ₹50,000+ in sponsorship and partnership value.

Every figure here comes from Darshil Jain's own one-page résumé and is marked self-reported where it cannot be independently verified.

## Work

### Operations Intern at Figmenta

- Role: Operations Intern, Figmenta
- When: Jan 2026 – Feb 2026
- Type: Work experience
- Page: https://wrapped-portfolio.vercel.app/case-studies/figmenta-operations-intern

Built the Asia team's project dashboard and a hiring workflow it can reuse.

Situation: Figmenta's Asia team ran 35+ projects across 15+ people without one shared view of progress, and needed a repeatable way to hire and onboard.

What Darshil did:

- Built and ran a centralized project-tracking dashboard in Notion and Excel covering 35+ projects and 15+ team members.
- Screened 500+ résumés, shortlisted 100+ candidates and managed onboarding for 5+ hires.
- Wrote structured hiring workflows and reusable onboarding decks for future hires.

Result: Clearer workflow visibility, on-time task execution and a hiring process the team can run again.

Figures (from the résumé):

- 35+ projects tracked: Projects covered by the centralized dashboard. (self-reported)
- 15+ team members on the dashboard: Asia team members covered by the dashboard. (self-reported)
- 500+ résumés screened: Résumés screened during hiring support at Figmenta. (self-reported)
- 100+ candidates shortlisted: Candidates shortlisted during hiring support. (self-reported)
- 5+ hires onboarded: Hires whose onboarding was managed. (self-reported)

Skills: Project Management, Process Optimization, Microsoft Excel, Notion
